topic: Why your paycheck withholding isn't your final tax bill

sources.claim: Employers withhold estimated tax based on IRS W-4 formulas; the true tax liability is reconciled when a return is filed; over-withholding results in a refund, which functions as an interest-free overpayment
sources.source: IRS Tax Withholding Estimator / Publication 505 (Tax Withholding and Estimated Tax)

disclaimer: Educational content only. Not personalized tax advice.
